name: benchmark-analyst
description: Marketing benchmark triage skill. Use whenever metrics are shared with questions like "is this good?", "is this normal?", or "should I worry?" — ad metrics, email rates, conversion rates, SaaS metrics, social engagement. Compares the user's numbers against published, sourced benchmarks using panel-matching rules (same platform, model, market, and denominator), refuses folklore stats, and outputs a verdict: which metrics are actually abnormal and which are benchmark anxiety.
